LESSON: COOKING FOOD ● STEWING ● BAKING (RUBBING-IN METHOD)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Cooking Food ● Stewing ● Baking (rubbing-in method)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cooking Food ● Stewing ● Baking (rubbing-in method), part of Food Production Processes in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we cook foods by baking? 2. How can we cook foods by stewing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cooking Food ● Stewing ● Baking (rubbing-in method) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Integrity: prudent use of resources and application of laid down procedure in stewing and baking foods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety of self and others while cooking food.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate measuring of ingredients for baking to measurement of weights learnt in Mathematics.
